sources.title: ACR practice parameters and technical standards

findings.label: Examination performed
findings.text: The examination was performed [to the standard protocol / with a modified protocol / as a limited examination].

sections.label: Area of concern
sections.normal: No abnormality is identified in the area of concern.

findings.label: Lesion
findings.text: A [cystic / solid / mixed cystic and solid / fatty] lesion is present in the area of concern.

findings.label: Size
findings.text: The lesion measures __ × __ × __ mm.

findings.label: Vascularity
findings.text: The lesion shows [no / peripheral / internal] Doppler vascularity.

findings.label: Appearance
findings.text: The appearances are of [a lymph node / a thyroglossal duct cyst / a branchial cleft cyst / a lipoma / an abscess / a haematoma].

sections.label: Parotid glands
sections.normal: The parotid glands are normal in size and echotexture, with no focal lesion.

findings.label: Parotid lesion
findings.text: A [solid / cystic / mixed] lesion is present in the [right / left] parotid gland.

findings.label: Lesion size
findings.text: The parotid lesion measures __ mm.

findings.label: Diffuse change
findings.text: The [right / left / both] parotid glands are [enlarged and hypoechoic / heterogeneous / atrophic].

findings.label: Calculus
findings.text: There is a [right / left] parotid duct calculus [with / without] duct dilatation.

sections.label: Submandibular glands
sections.normal: The submandibular glands are normal in size and echotexture, with no focal lesion.

findings.label: Submandibular lesion
findings.text: A [solid / cystic / mixed] lesion is present in the [right / left] submandibular gland.

findings.label: Lesion size
findings.text: The submandibular lesion measures __ mm.

findings.label: Diffuse change
findings.text: The [right / left / both] submandibular glands are [enlarged and hypoechoic / heterogeneous / atrophic].

findings.label: Calculus
findings.text: There is a [right / left] submandibular duct calculus [with / without] duct dilatation.

sections.label: Thyroid gland
sections.normal: The thyroid gland is normal in size and echotexture, with no nodule.

findings.label: Thyroid nodule
findings.text: A thyroid nodule is present in the [right lobe / left lobe / isthmus].

findings.label: Nodule size
findings.text: The thyroid nodule measures __ mm.

findings.label: ACR TI-RADS
findings.text: The nodule is ACR TI-RADS [TR1 / TR2 / TR3 / TR4 / TR5].

findings.label: Diffuse change
findings.text: The thyroid gland is [enlarged / heterogeneous / diffusely hypoechoic / hypervascular].

sections.label: Right neck
sections.normal: No morphologically abnormal lymph node is seen in levels I to VI of the right neck.

findings.label: Abnormal right neck node
findings.text: An abnormal right level [I / II / III / IV / V / VI] lymph node is present.

findings.label: Short axis
findings.text: The right neck node measures __ mm in short axis.

findings.label: Node features
findings.text: The node shows [loss of the fatty hilum / a round shape / cystic change / necrosis / calcification / peripheral vascularity].

sections.label: Left neck
sections.normal: No morphologically abnormal lymph node is seen in levels I to VI of the left neck.

findings.label: Abnormal left neck node
findings.text: An abnormal left level [I / II / III / IV / V / VI] lymph node is present.

findings.label: Short axis
findings.text: The left neck node measures __ mm in short axis.

findings.label: Node features
findings.text: The node shows [loss of the fatty hilum / a round shape / cystic change / necrosis / calcification / peripheral vascularity].

sections.label: Vessels
sections.normal: The carotid arteries and internal jugular veins are patent.

findings.label: Venous thrombus
findings.text: There is thrombus in the [right / left] internal jugular vein.

findings.label: Carotid disease
findings.text: There is [plaque / stenosis / occlusion] of the [right / left] common carotid artery.

sections.label: Muscles and soft tissues
sections.normal: The neck muscles and subcutaneous soft tissues are normal.

findings.label: Soft tissue abnormality
findings.text: There is [a collection / oedema / a haematoma / a soft tissue mass / fibromatosis colli] in the [right / left / midline] neck.

ct.chest-abdomen-pelvis.title: CT chest, abdomen and pelvis with contrast

findings.label: Examination performed
findings.text: The examination was performed [to the standard protocol / with a modified protocol / as a limited examination].

sections.label: Lungs and airways
sections.normal: The lungs are clear, with no pulmonary nodule, mass or consolidation, and the central airways are patent.

findings.label: Pulmonary nodule
findings.text: A pulmonary nodule is present in the [right upper lobe / right middle lobe / right lower lobe / left upper lobe / lingula / left lower lobe].

findings.label: Nodule size
findings.text: The pulmonary nodule measures __ mm.

findings.label: Lung abnormality
findings.text: There is [a mass / consolidation / lymphangitic thickening / atelectasis] in the [right lung / left lung / both lungs].

findings.label: Airway abnormality
findings.text: There is [bronchial wall thickening / an endobronchial lesion / bronchial obstruction].

sections.label: Pleura and pericardium
sections.normal: No pleural or pericardial effusion.

findings.label: Pleural effusion
findings.text: There is a [small / moderate / large] [right / left / bilateral] pleural effusion.

findings.label: Pleural disease
findings.text: There is [right / left / bilateral] pleural [thickening / nodularity].

findings.label: Pericardial effusion
findings.text: There is a [small / moderate / large] pericardial effusion.

sections.label: Thoracic lymph nodes
sections.normal: No mediastinal, hilar or axillary lymphadenopathy.

findings.label: Enlarged node
findings.text: An enlarged [mediastinal / hilar / axillary / supraclavicular] lymph node is present.

findings.label: Short axis
findings.text: The thoracic lymph node measures __ mm in short axis.

sections.label: Heart and great vessels
sections.normal: The heart and great vessels are normal.

findings.label: Cardiovascular abnormality
findings.text: There is [a pulmonary embolus / tumour thrombus / cardiomegaly / an aortic aneurysm / coronary artery calcification].

sections.label: Liver
sections.normal: No focal liver lesion.

findings.label: Liver lesion
findings.text: A focal liver lesion is present in the [right lobe / left lobe / caudate lobe].

findings.label: Lesion size
findings.text: The liver lesion measures __ mm.

findings.label: Lesion appearance
findings.text: The liver lesion is [hypodense / hyperenhancing / cystic / indeterminate].

findings.label: Diffuse liver disease
findings.text: The liver shows [steatosis / cirrhotic morphology / hepatomegaly].

sections.label: Gallbladder, pancreas and spleen
sections.normal: The gallbladder, pancreas and spleen are normal.

findings.label: Abnormality
findings.text: There is [a pancreatic lesion / pancreatic duct dilatation / a splenic lesion / splenomegaly / gallstones / biliary dilatation].

sections.label: Adrenal glands
sections.normal: The adrenal glands are normal.

findings.label: Adrenal nodule
findings.text: There is a [right / left] adrenal nodule.

findings.label: Nodule size
findings.text: The adrenal nodule measures __ mm.

sections.label: Kidneys and bladder
sections.normal: The kidneys and bladder are normal, with no hydronephrosis.

findings.label: Renal lesion
findings.text: There is a [renal cyst / renal mass / renal calculus] in the [right / left] kidney.

findings.label: Hydronephrosis
findings.text: There is [right / left / bilateral] hydronephrosis.

findings.label: Bladder abnormality
findings.text: There is [bladder wall thickening / a bladder mass].

sections.label: Bowel and peritoneum
sections.normal: The bowel is normal in calibre, with no wall thickening, ascites or peritoneal nodularity.

findings.label: Bowel abnormality
findings.text: There is [bowel wall thickening / a bowel mass / bowel obstruction] involving the [stomach / small bowel / colon / rectum].

findings.label: Peritoneal disease
findings.text: There is [ascites / peritoneal nodularity / omental disease / a collection].

sections.label: Reproductive organs
sections.normal: The reproductive organs are unremarkable.

findings.label: Abnormality
findings.text: There is [an adnexal mass / a uterine mass / prostatic enlargement / a prostatic lesion].

sections.label: Abdominal and pelvic lymph nodes
sections.normal: No abdominal or pelvic lymphadenopathy.

findings.label: Enlarged node
findings.text: An enlarged [retroperitoneal / mesenteric / pelvic / inguinal] lymph node is present.

findings.label: Short axis
findings.text: The abdominal or pelvic lymph node measures __ mm in short axis.

sections.label: Bones
sections.normal: No suspicious bone lesion.

findings.label: Bone lesion
findings.text: There is a [lytic / sclerotic / mixed] bone lesion in the [spine / ribs / pelvis / sternum / proximal femur / proximal humerus].

findings.label: Pathological fracture
findings.text: The bone lesion [has / does not have] an associated pathological fracture.

sections.label: Target lesions
sections.normal: No measurable disease.

findings.label: Measurable disease
findings.text: Measurable disease is present.

findings.label: Sum of diameters
findings.text: The sum of target lesion diameters is __ mm.

findings.label: Response
findings.text: The response is [complete response / partial response / stable disease / progressive disease] by RECIST 1.1.
